audit_of_unscreened_scopus_remainder.interpretation: The clear rate in this stratum is several times the rate measured in the parent remainder in September. The likely reason is that the Scopus queries name this review's subject matter directly and Scopus matches them against indexed keywords as well as title and abstract, so a record can be squarely on topic and still score below a threshold built from title and abstract words. The ordering rule and its threshold were left unchanged, because they were registered before the first screen; what changes is the size of the declared gap.
audit_of_unscreened_scopus_remainder.not_a_measured_ratio: The two strata were judged by the same assistant on different days from differently formatted listings, so the difference between the two rates is not a measurement of anything. Comparing them properly would mean judging the parent frame again under this round's procedure, which has not been done.
